title: resourceConfig
responsibility: Resolves the shared resource directory and atomically reads or writes validated reserve configuration.

inputs.name: resourceHome.env
inputs.description: Resource and caller environment used to resolve paths or bounded worker settings; unrelated credentials are not newly propagated.

inputs.name: resourceConfig.home
inputs.description: Filesystem directory containing this queue SQLite database and validated reserve configuration.

inputs.name: saveResourceConfig.config
inputs.description: Validated reserve floors and telemetry timing limits; lower safety thresholds are rejected.

inputs.name: saveResourceConfig.home
inputs.description: Filesystem directory containing this queue SQLite database and validated reserve configuration.

outputs.name: resourceHome
outputs.description: Absolute shared resource directory from the override or the user-scoped Harness default.

outputs.name: resourceConfig
outputs.description: Validated persisted configuration, or validated defaults when no file exists.

outputs.name: saveResourceConfig
outputs.description: Atomically replaces private configuration after validation.
